Facebook buzz: Your live video in Victory Day theme
2016-12-08T16:07:26+06:00 | SMA Ronie
https://www.thedailystar.net/bytes/facebook-buzz-your-live-video-victory-day-theme-1327045

This year, you can live stream on Facebook with a custom frame designed in the theme of Victory Day with the slogan of "Proud to be a Bangladeshi".

The mobile application " Bijoy 71 " will help you share Victory Day greetings, from anywhere in the world, on Facebook with the green and red Bangladesh theme.

Coming in to mark the 46th year of victory, the app will customise the video frame with hastag "#ProudToBeBangladeshi".

[facebook href="https://www.facebook.com/bijoy71.net/videos/742650072555610/" width="500"][/facebook]

The customised frame for live videos will be an addition to the ongoing practice of framing profile pictures, Mofizur Rahman Tipu, managing director of developers Ezze Tech Ltd , told The Daily Star.

Shahab Uddin Riadh, marketing head of Ezze Tech Ltd, is delighted to introduce the product and said it is a fruit of the developers' hard work for the last three months.

The app can be downloaded and installed from Website ( click here ) or from Google Play Store ( click here ).
